summary_en: 3.0M shares (3.5% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥2.0B ceiling, open-market acquisition 22Jul–30Sep2026. Concurrently, up to 4.0M shares (4.7% of S/O) to be cancelled on 30Sep2026, comprising all shares acquired plus 1.0M shares held in treasury.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters relating to treasury stock acquisition and cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Insource's board on 21July2026 authorized the acquisition of up to 3.0 million shares (3.5% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an upper limit of ¥2.0 billion via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Execution window is 22July through 30September2026. Concurrently, the board resolved to cancel up to 4.0 million shares (4.7% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) on 30September2026, comprising all shares acquired under this program plus 1.0 million shares currently held in treasury. The stated rationale is to optimize capital structure and enhance shareholder returns while maintaining agility in capital allocation amid a rapidly changing operating environment. The company prioritizes investment in future growth while reviewing cash position and capital efficiency holistically.
